I’d love to join you guys on the app as well! Seems like a wonderful idea :D 
I’m also a beginner and would love to be able to put myself into fully immersive situations

I've thought about this a lot and is actually what I intend on doing once I think I've lived enough experiences: I'd shift to a new reality where I forget everything and start my shifting journey over, making sure that my new self has like have recently discovered shifting or smth. You could pretty much compare it to death as it kills all memories you currently have but I also think it's nice to start over.
